answer: The voyage schedule is applied in pearl and onyx shows each instalment. A payout is split so that 46% arrives at settlement and the rest over 5 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. Someone thus cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3843 identities would post 4115 proofs and burn roughly 60 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
